clips.title: The story
paras: At Northshire Abbey, Brother Paxton is frustrated by misplaced and missing tomes. He asks young adventurers to find Daniel, his daydreaming assistant, and take stock of the library archives, but Daniel's thoughts keep wandering to local tradeskills, making a straight answer hard to get.

Northshire Abbey preserves old scholarly works, spiritual writings, and historical records that survived the First War in the Kingdom of Stormwind. Brother Paxton, a meticulous monk, takes great pride in the collection. Lately, books have gone missing from the shelves, and Paxton needs a clear inventory to learn how widespread the loss is. He has little patience to chase after his daydreaming helper.

Daniel works as Brother Paxton's assistant in the abbey library, but his thoughts rarely stay with parchment and catalog numbers. He is fascinated by the practical trades of Elwynn Forest: smithing, leatherworking, tailoring, and herbal craft. Paxton grows exasperated as inventory work leads Daniel to ramble about local crafters instead of locating lost scriptures.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We need to take stock of how many books are missing!
Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.
He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.
Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.
It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.
While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.
